steps.label: UCPath Authentication
steps.note: Announce-only step (ctx.markStep). Kernel-managed UCPath login via loginToUCPath. ctx.page('ucpath') blocks until auth resolves.

operations.label: Await UCPath login
operations.summary: ctx.markStep('ucpath-auth'); ctx.page('ucpath') blocks until kernel loginToUCPath resolves

steps.label: PayPath Transaction
steps.note: Executes buildWorkStudyPlan — a 9-stage ActionPlan (sequential). All form interactions operate inside the PeopleSoft iframe via getContentFrame(page).

operations.label: Navigate to Smart HR / PayPath Actions
Wait for Smart HR page ready
Expand PayPath/Additional Pay in HR Tasks sidebar
Wait 2s for sidebar expansion
Click PayPath Actions sub-item in sidebar
Wait for PayPath Actions search page ready
Check sidebar aria-expanded state
Collapse sidebar (conditional)
operations.note: Only clicked when aria-expanded === 'true'. Required to prevent sidebar intercepting iframe button clicks.

operations.label: Fill Empl ID in PayPath search form
Click Search
Wait for iframe reload after search
operations.summary: page.waitForTimeout(5000) + networkidle(15s). PeopleSoft reloads iframe content on search.

operations.label: Check for PeopleSoft payroll-in-progress alert dialog
operations.summary: isVisible({ timeout: 2000 }) — alert may appear with 'payroll in progress' warning

operations.label: Dismiss PeopleSoft alert dialog (conditional)
operations.note: Only clicked if alert is visible. Followed by waitForTimeout(2000).

operations.label: Scrape employee name from Position Data header
operations.summary: textContent() → wsCtx.employeeName; propagated later via ctx.updateData({ name: wsCtx.employeeName })

operations.label: Fill Effective Date in Position Data tab
Fill Position Change Reason
Fill Position Pool
Click Job Data tab
Wait for Job Data tab load
Fill Job Data Comments
operations.note: comments = 'Updated pool id to F per work study award {effectiveDate}'

operations.label: Click Additional Pay Data tab
Wait for Additional Pay Data tab load
Fill Initiator's Comments
operations.note: Same comments template as Job Data Comments

operations.label: Click Save and Submit
operations.summary: waitForSaveEnabled(btn, { timeoutMs: 15000 }) then safeClick; called via clickSaveAndSubmit from enter.ts

operations.label: Wait for PeopleSoft processing after submit
Assert no error banner after submit
operations.summary: errorLocator.count() > 0 → extract error text, return { success: false, error }; handler throws if !result.success

operations.label: Click OK on transaction confirmation page
Scrape transaction number from Smart HR Transactions list
operations.summary: readLatestTransactionNumber(page, emplId) — re-navigates to Smart HR Transactions, polls up to 15s for newly-submitted row matching EID, extracts T-number

notes: Single-system workflow (ucpath only). No delegation, no fan-out, no parallel branches.
ucpath-auth step is announce-only (ctx.markStep); actual UCPath login is kernel-managed via requireLogin(loginToUCPath).
All PeopleSoft form interactions operate inside the main iframe via getContentFrame(page) — same pattern as onboarding.
Sidebar collapse is a guard step: sidebar must be collapsed before clicking iframe buttons or PeopleSoft intercepts the events.
waitForPageReady helper (3s + networkidle) is called after initial navigation, after each tab click. Search result uses a longer 5s + networkidle wait.
Position Pool is hardcoded to 'F'; Position Change Reason hardcoded to 'JRL'.
comments template: 'Updated pool id to F per work study award {effectiveDate}' — written to both Job Data Comments and Initiator's Comments fields.

Known idempotency gap: no pre-submit dupe probe exists. A kernel retry after a successful submit will re-submit the PayPath transaction. Fix pattern: scan Smart HR Transactions list for an existing pending transaction (see separations' findExistingTerminationTransaction). Until fixed, operators must manually verify before retrying.
Employee name is scraped from the PeopleSoft Position Data header after search and propagated via ctx.updateData({ name }) at the end of the transaction step.
